summary: Itau Unibanco filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2Q26 quarterly results, including recurring net income of R$12.4 billion, ROE of 24.3%, CET1 of 12.3%, and loan portfolio growth. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, capital return, restructuring, or other corporate event is described. The exhibit includes press and institutional presentations on the results, with forward-looking statements. There are no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations. The SEC filing maps to a standard Form 6-K earnings release. What to watch: ongoing quarterly operational performance, credit quality, and capital metrics.
